title: Hearty Tender Moroccan Broad Beans Zaalouk
description: A traditional Moroccan dish featuring tender broad beans in a rich and flavorful tomato sauce, perfect for a cozy dinner. This satvik-friendly recipe is fermented to bring out the best flavors.
instructions: Rinse the dried broad beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the broad beans, then transfer them to a large pot with enough water to cover them.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 30 minutes or until the broad beans are tender.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, then cook for 1 minute.
Add the canned tomatoes, lemon juice, and cooked broad beans to the skillet, then stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the zaalouk for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the flavors have melded together and the sauce has thickened.
